limits_note: 2× storage as monthly shared-link traffic; on exceed links are suspended until next month
reliability_note: The 2× link-traffic rule is a genuine trap for serving: 10 TB stored → 20 TB/mo shared-link traffic, i.e. ~666 GB/day, which is just under the 500 GB-1 TiB/day serving band. It would work at the low end of serving and break at the top.
